nodes.text: Fresh from the Roaring Pool, cold as the falls that filled it! You, yes, you look hungry and I have never once been wrong.

choices.text: Do prices really climb by dusk?

nodes.text: Fish for the pot, coal for the grate, ore for them as dig. All of it here at the gate, none of it walked up a single stair, and the price says thank you for that.

When a caravan's in? They climb by the hour. Trout does not keep and carters do not wait, and between those two facts lives my entire fortune. Buy now. I say that to everyone, and by dusk I am always right.
By dusk you'll wish you had! No hard feelings. Mind the ice on the pool steps.
